Marta: hey @ravi @lea — we need a compact bench deliverable for the launch page + webinar. essentials: p50/p95/p99, tokens/s, and GPU mem for seq lengths 512/2048/8192. please include cold vs warmed cache. deadline: 72h. keep artifacts minimal (CSV + one README).

Ravi: noted. fp16 baseline + int8 quant? and do you want a small real prompt set + synthetic stress set?

Jules: yes real set (~12 prompts) + synthetic (~150). i'll upload in marketing/assets. reps: 50 for real, 200 for synthetic.

Lea: plan: smoke run today on synthetic 50 reps, then full runs int8/fp16 across cache states. CSV schema: run_id,model,quant,seq,cache,p50,p95,p99,tokens_s,gpu_mem,notes. we'll add kernel_id if we see fallbacks.

infra-bot: infra note: 8k runs may be scheduled on larger instance; @ops alerted.

Marta: can you push the smoke CSV within 24h? marketing will draft slide with p95. please mark outputs internal until we sign off.

Ravi: yes — smoke CSV tomorrow morning, full artifacts in 72h. we'll include raw logs and README with exact commands. thanks all.
